messages.subject: Can I print run error on shiny UI with a single function?
parts:
I have a shiny app that has dozens of procedures.From time to time there is an error that halts the program.
I need to let the user see that the app halts ( he doesn't see the console).I can use try-catch but It will be
 hard and not elegant to do it for every single procedure.Is there any way to do this?
